content.text:
**Defining the Scope**
I've zeroed in on the core of the request: railway switchyards. My initial analysis clarifies the scope - a 600-word piece, no tools, and a focus on direct answers. The constraints are clearly defined, which helps narrow the scope of the responses.

**Outlining the Essay**
I am now focusing on structuring the essay. I've broken it down into an introduction, core anatomy/components, mechanics, and technological evolution. The word count targets are set, and now it's about crafting the essay sections. The classification mechanics are clearly the focal point.

**Expanding the Framework**
I'm now expanding the focus to include programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and yard management software (YMS) within the mechanics. My conclusion will address the vital role of switchyards in supply chains, efficiency, and modern rail freight. I have decided on the essay title, "The Iron Labyrinth: Inside the Railway Switchyard", and have also begun drafting the introduction.
